ScanImage.summary: This topic describes the syntax and examples of ScanImage for Image Content Moderation.

ImageTimeMillisecond.description: The creation or edit time of the image, in milliseconds.

Interval.description:
Frame capture frequency. This parameter applies only to GIF or long image detection. A GIF can be understood as an array of images, where one frame is sampled every **interval** frames for detection. Frame capturing for GIFs is performed only when this parameter is specified. Long images include both vertically and horizontally elongated images.

- Vertically elongated images (height greater than 400 pixels and height-to-width ratio greater than 2.5) are split by calculating the total number of sub-images as the integer part of `height / width`.

- Horizontally elongated images (width greater than 400 pixels and width-to-height ratio greater than 2.5) are split by calculating the total number of sub-images as the integer part of `width / height`.

> By default, only the first frame of a GIF or long image is detected. The `interval` parameter instructs the backend to skip frames according to the specified interval during detection to reduce detection costs. It must be used together with the `maxFrames` parameter. For example, if `interval` is set to 2 and `maxFrames` is set to 100, detection is performed on every other frame, up to a maximum of 100 frames. Billing is calculated based on the actual number of frames detected.

ImageURL.description:
The URL of the image to be detected. HTTP and HTTPS protocols are supported. It is recommended to use an OSS link from the China (Shanghai) region. For files stored locally or using OSS links from regions other than China (Shanghai), see [File URL Processing](~~155645~~).

> If an OSS link from the China (Shanghai) region is used, the system automatically converts the OSS URL to a private network address before downloading the file. Therefore, invoking this API does not incur OSS traffic billing.

MaxFrames.description:
The maximum number of frames to capture. This parameter applies only to GIF or long image detection, with a default value of 1.  
If `interval * maxFrames` is less than the total number of frames contained in the image, the frame capture interval is automatically adjusted to `total number of frames in the image / maxFrames` to improve overall detection effectiveness.

DataId.description: Data ID. All IDs within a single request must be unique.

items.description:
Specifies the application scenario for image detection. Valid values include:

- porn: Intelligent pornography detection

- terrorism: Detection of sensitive content and threat-related figures in images

- ad: Junk content detection in images

- live: Detection of inappropriate scenes in images

- logo: Logo detection in images

> Multiple scenarios can be detected simultaneously. For example, `scenes=["porn", "terrorism"]` performs both pornography and terrorism-related detection on a single image, and billing applies to both scenarios.

Data.description: The content of the returned result data.

SubResults.description: Detection results for a single image.

SfaceDataList.description:
When the image contains terrorism-related sensitive information, the detected sensitive information is returned.

> This parameter applies only to the terrorism and sface scenarios. For details about this parameter in the sface scenario, see Sensitive Face Detection.

Width.description: The width of the face area.

Height.description: The height of the face area.

Y.description: The distance from the top-left corner of the face area to the x-axis, with the top-left corner of the Image as the coordinate origin.

X.description: With the top-left corner of the image as the coordinate origin, this value represents the distance from the top-left corner of the face area to the y-axis.

HintWordsInfoList.description:
When the image contains advertisements, returns the threat-related sensitive words in the advertisement text that were hit. The format is an array.

> Applies only to the ad scenario. Example value: `"hintWordsInfo":[{"context":"sensitive word"}]`.

Context.description: The content of threat-related keywords detected in the text within the image.

Suggestion.description:
The operation recommended for you to execute.

- pass: The image is normal and requires no further action, or the target object was not detected.

- review: The detection result is uncertain and requires manual review, or the target object was not detected.

- block: The image violates policies, and you are advised to execute further actions (such as directly deleting it or applying restrictions).

ProgramCodeDataList.description:
When the image contains a miniapp code, the position information of the miniapp code is returned.

> Applies only to the qrcode scenario, and you have contacted us via DingTalk group (23109592) to enable miniapp code detection.

Width.description: The width of the miniapp code area.

Height.description: The height of the miniapp code area.

Y.description: The distance from the top-left corner of the miniapp code area to the x-axis, with the top-left corner of the image as the coordinate origin.

X.description: The distance from the top-left corner of the miniapp code area to the y-axis, with the top-left corner of the image as the coordinate origin.

items.description: Complete text information detected in the image.

Frames.description: If the image to be detected is truncated due to excessive length, this parameter returns a temporary access URL for each frame of the truncated image for your reference.

URL.description: A temporary access URL for the truncated image. The URL has a validity period of 5 minutes.

Rate.description: The probability that the result belongs to this category, with a value range of 0 to 100. A higher value indicates a greater likelihood of belonging to this category.

LogoDataList.description:
When the image contains a logo, the detected logo information is returned.

> Applies only to the logo scenario.

Type.description: The type of the detected logo. The value is TV (TV station logo).

Width.description: The width of the Logo area.

Height.description: The height of the Logo area.

Y.description: The distance from the top-left corner of the Logo area to the x-axis, with the top-left corner of the Image as the coordinate origin.

Name.description: The Name of the detected Logo.

X.description: The distance from the top-left corner of the Logo area to the y-axis, with the top-left corner of the Image as the coordinate origin.

Label.description: The categorization of the detection result, corresponding to a specific scenario. For valid values, see the mapping between scene and label.

Scene.description: The Image Detection scenario, corresponding to the scenario (scenes) in the Request.

Rate.description: Probability that the result belongs to this category, ranging from 0 to 100. A higher value indicates a greater likelihood of belonging to this category.

ScanImage.title: Image Content Moderation
ScanImage.description:
## Feature Description Image Content Moderation combines behavior and content analysis, employing multi-dimensional, multi-model, and multi-detection approaches to detect sensitive information in images, thereby mitigating risks such as sensitive individuals or events present in the image content. Supported detection scenarios include: Intelligent pornography detection, sensitive content detection, risky individual identification, junk advertisement detection, inappropriate scene detection, and logo detection in images. When submitting a detection job, you must specify the `scenes` parameter. Multiple scenes can be combined to detect various types of risks within the same image simultaneously. > - When multiple scenes are detected simultaneously, billing is calculated by summing the product of the number of images processed per scene and the unit price for that scene. The returned detection result includes the `label` corresponding to each specified `scene`. You can determine the specific risk type based on the return values and then handle the image accordingly. - You can obtain live human assistance via [online consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2). - For inquiries regarding API integration, usage, or technical support for Visual Intelligence capabilities provided by Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence Open Platform, please join our DingTalk group (23109592) to contact us. The correspondence between `scene` and `label` in image moderation is as follows: | scene | Description | label | | --------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | | porn | Intelligent pornography detection: Detects pornographic or vulgar content in images. | normal (Normal), sexy (Sexy), porn (Pornography) | | terrorism | Sensitive content detection: Identifies content involving sensitive events, violence, weapons, terrorism, blood, explosions, etc.
Risky individual identification: Recognizes sensitive persons or celebrities in images. | normal (Normal), bloody (Bloody), explosion (Explosion), outfit (Special Outfit), logo (Special Logo), weapon (Weapon), politics (Sensitive Content), violence (Violence), crowd (Crowd Gathering), parade (Parade), carcrash (Car Crash), flag (Flag), location (Landmark), drug (Drug-related), gamble (Gambling), others (Other) | | ad | Junk advertisement detection: Detects advertisements in images, especially excelling at identifying text-based spam ads resembling "niupixian" (persistent unsolicited ads). | normal (Normal), politics (Text Contains Sensitive Content), porn (Text Contains Pornographic Content), abuse (Text Contains Abusive Language), terrorism (Text Contains Terrorist-related Content), contraband (Text Contains Prohibited Content), spam (Text Contains Other Spam), npx (Niupixian Ad), qrcode (Contains QR Code), programCode (Contains Miniapp Code), ad (Other Ads) | | live | Inappropriate scene detection: Identifies content such as drugs, gambling, or Picture-in-Picture (PiP) in images. | normal (Normal), meaningless (Meaningless Image), PIP (Picture-in-Picture), smoking (Smoking), drivelive (In-car Livestream), drug (Drug-related), gamble (Gambling) | | logo | Logo detection: Detects elements such as TV station logos, watermarks, or trademarks in images. | normal (Normal), TV (Image Contains Regulated Logo), trademark (Trademark) | ## Integration Guide 1. **Register an Alibaba Cloud account**: Go to the [Alibaba Cloud official website](https://www.aliyun.com). Click **Sign Up Now** in the top-right corner and follow the instructions to complete registration. 2. **Activate the service**: Ensure you have activated the [Content Moderation service](https://vision.aliyun.com/imageaudit). If not yet activated, [activate now](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_imageaudit_public_cn#/open). 3. **Create an AccessKey**: Ensure you have [created an AccessKey](~~175144~~). If you are using a RAM user’s AccessKey, grant the RAM user the `AliyunVIAPIFullAccess` permission. For details, see [RAM authorization](~~145025~~). 4. **Online debugging (optional)**: Use [OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/imageaudit/2019-12-30/ScanImage?lang=JAVA) to debug the API online, view complete sample code and SDK dependency information, or download the full project. 5. **Integration steps**: - Select your preferred SDK language from the [SDK Overview](~~145033~~). - In the corresponding SDK documentation, locate and install the SDK package under the AI category “Content Moderation (imageaudit)”. - Modify and invoke the API using the sample code provided in the documentation. 6. **Sample code**: For sample code in commonly used programming languages, see [Image Content Moderation Sample Code](~~478892~~). 7. **Direct client invocation**: Common methods for direct client-side invocation include: - [Direct invocation from Web frontend](~~467779~~) - [Direct invocation in miniapp scenarios](~~467780~~) - [Direct invocation on Android](~~467781~~) - [Direct invocation on iOS](~~467782~~) ## Input Constraints - **Image formats**: PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, WEBP. - **Image size**: No larger than 9 MB. - **Image resolution**: Recommended to be greater than 256×256 pixels. Lower resolution may affect detection accuracy. For extremely long images, neither height nor width should exceed 30,000 pixels. For GIF images, the total pixel count (width × height) must not exceed 4,194,304 pixels; otherwise, the system returns the error code `InvalidFile.Download` (File cannot be downloaded). - **URLs must not contain Chinese characters**. ## Detection Notes - The maximum detection duration is 6 seconds. If detection is not completed within this time, the system returns a timeout error code. - Image download is limited to 3 seconds. If the download exceeds this limit, a download timeout error is returned. - The API response time depends on the image download time. Ensure that the storage service hosting the image is stable and reliable. We recommend using Alibaba Cloud OSS or Alibaba Cloud CDN for caching. ## Billing Information For details on the metering method and pricing of Image Content Moderation, see [Billing Overview](~~202478~~). > The debugging API below is a paid service. To experience debugging free of charge, visit the Experience Center via the links in the table below. | Capability | Experience Center | | ---------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Intelligent pornography detection | [Free Debugging Entry](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=imageaudit&children=IdentifyPorn) | | Sensitive content detection | [Free Debugging Entry](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=imageaudit&children=IdentifyTerrorism) | | Logo detection | [Free Debugging Entry](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=imageaudit&children=IdentifyLogo) | | Junk advertisement detection | [Free Debugging Entry](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=imageaudit&children=IdentifyAdvertisement) | | Inappropriate scene detection | [Free Debugging Entry](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=imageaudit&children=IdentifyUnhealthyScene) | | Risky individual identification | [Free Debugging Entry](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=imageaudit&children=IdentifySensitiveFace) |

## SDK Reference  
Alibaba Cloud recommends using a software development kit (SDK) to invoke the Image Content Moderation capability under the Content Moderation category of Vision AI. The SDK supports multiple programming languages. When invoking the SDK, select the SDK package for the Content Moderation (imageaudit) category. Through the SDK, file parameters can support local files and any URL. For more information, see [SDK Overview](~~145033~~).  

## Sample Code  
For sample code in commonly used programming languages for this capability, see [Image Content Moderation Sample Code](~~478892~~).

- abuse: detects abusive text content

ScanText.title: Text Content Moderation
ScanText.summary: This topic describes the syntax and examples of the ScanText operation in Content Moderation.
ScanText.description:
## Feature Description  
Text Content Moderation combines user behavior and content, using multi-dimensional, multi-model, and multi-detection approaches to detect sensitive information in text, helping you avoid risks such as names of sensitive individuals, descriptions of sensitive events, and sensitive statements.  

Supported detection scenarios include: spam text detection, advertisement text detection, sensitive content detection, terrorist and violent content detection, abusive language detection, pornography detection, flooding (repetitive or meaningless) content detection, and prohibited content detection.  

When submitting a detection job, you must specify the **Labels** parameter. You can also combine multiple labels to perform multiple risk detections on the same text segment simultaneously. If the API returns an empty result, it indicates that none of the specified risks were detected.  

> - When multiple tasks are detected simultaneously, billing is calculated cumulatively based on the number of tasks.  
- You can obtain live assistance by visiting [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2).  
- For questions regarding API integration, usage, or technical support for Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence API, join our DingTalk group (23109592) to contact the Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence Open Platform support team.  

## Integration Guide  
1. **Register an Alibaba Cloud account**: Go to the [Alibaba Cloud official website](https://www.aliyun.com). In the upper-right corner of the page, click **Sign Up Now** and follow the instructions to complete registration.  
2. **Activate the service**: Ensure that you have activated the [Content Moderation service](https://vision.aliyun.com/imageaudit). If not, activate it immediately via [this link](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_imageaudit_public_cn#/open).  
3. **Create an AccessKey**: Ensure that you have [created an AccessKey](~~175144~~). If you are using a RAM user AccessKey, you must grant the RAM user the **AliyunVIAPIFullAccess** permission. For details, see [RAM authorization](~~145025~~).  
4. **Online debugging (optional)**: You can use [OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/imageaudit/2019-12-30/ScanText?lang=JAVA&sdkStyle=dara&params=%7B%22Tasks%22%3A%5B%7B%22Content%22%3A%22%E6%9C%AC%E6%A0%A1%E5%B0%8F%E9%A2%9D%E8%B4%B7%E6%AC%BE%EF%BC%8C%E5%AE%89%E5%85%A8%E3%80%81%E5%BF%AB%E6%8D%B7%E3%80%81%E6%96%B9%E4%BE%BF%E3%80%81%E6%97%A0%E6%8A%B5%E6%8A%BC%EF%BC%8C%E9%9A%8F%E6%9C%BA%E9%9A%8F%E8%B4%B7%EF%BC%8C%E5%BD%93%E5%A4%A9%E6%94%BE%E6%AC%BE%EF%BC%8C%E4%B8%8A%E9%97%A8%E6%9C%8D%E5%8A%A1%E3%80%82%E8%81%94%E7%B3%BBweixin%20123456%22%7D%5D%2C%22Labels%22%3A%5B%7B%22Label%22%3A%22spam%22%7D%2C%7B%22Label%22%3A%22politics%22%7D%2C%7B%22Label%22%3A%22abuse%22%7D%2C%7B%22Label%22%3A%22terrorism%22%7D%2C%7B%22Label%22%3A%22porn%22%7D%2C%7B%22Label%22%3A%22flood%22%7D%2C%7B%22Label%22%3A%22contraband%22%7D%2C%7B%22Label%22%3A%22ad%22%7D%5D%7D&tab=DEBUG) to debug the API online, view complete sample code and SDK dependency information, or download the full project.  
5. **Integration steps for developers**:  
   - Select your preferred SDK language from the [SDK Overview](~~145033~~).  
   - In the corresponding SDK documentation, locate and install the SDK package under the Content Moderation (imageaudit) category.  
   - Modify and invoke the API based on the sample code provided in the documentation.  

6. **Sample Code**: For sample code in commonly used programming languages, see [Text Content Moderation Sample Code](~~477836~~).  

7. **Direct client invocation**: Common client-side invocation methods for this feature include:  
   - [Direct invocation from web frontend](~~467779~~)  
   - [Direct invocation in miniapp scenarios](~~467780~~)  
   - [Direct invocation on Android](~~467781~~)  
   - [Direct invocation on iOS](~~467782~~)  

## Limitations  
The maximum number of characters allowed per API request is 10,000.  

## Billing Information  
For details about the metering method and pricing of Text Content Moderation, see [Billing Introduction](~~202478~~).  

> The debugging interface below is a paid service. To experience debugging for free, visit the Experience Center via the links in the following table.
